slides.title: The ==~ key== breaks the SAT's hardest question

slides.stem:
The equation

$\frac{24x^2 + 25x - 47}{ax - 2} = -8x - 3 - \frac{53}{ax - 2}$

is true for all valid values of $x$, where $a$ is a constant. What is the value of $a$?
slides.hand: the most feared question on the test

slides.title: Swap = for ~ and Desmos finds a
slides.question: The equation above is true for all valid values of $x$. What is the value of $a$?
slides.caption: Type the equation with $\sim$ in place of $=$ and Desmos solves for the parameter.

slides.title: = draws. ~ solves.
slides.body: With =, Desmos draws exactly what you typed. With ~, it treats unknown letters as parameters and finds the values that make both sides match — which is precisely what "true for all x" is asking. RMSE of zero means the fit is perfect: the dashed and solid curves are the same curve.
